fullTests.rerunScope: The complete suite ran once for candidate2. After the test-only timeout correction, only the affected file was rerun; no claim of a second full-suite pass.

holdout.interpretation: Overall additional gain over 78d125d under the fixed-bid mirrored protocol; WP lower confidence bound exceeds 5pp and both WP/ADP lower bounds are positive. Lower-farmer WP point estimate -0.2pp with interval [-3.6,3.4]; do not claim improvement or non-inferiority for all roles. Farmer mirroring changes both partner and opponent; role intervals are exploratory and unadjusted.
